field_inventory.name: app_id
field_inventory.description: Documented mandatory store app identifier. Preserve Android package names and iTunes identifiers without inferring a shared numeric grammar.

field_inventory.name: event
field_inventory.description: Documented mandatory event name. Examples do not close the event vocabulary.

field_inventory.name: partner
field_inventory.description: Documented mandatory tracking partner name; registration is external.

field_inventory.name: key
field_inventory.description: Documented mandatory partner key issued by Remerge; no local issuance or acceptance check.

field_inventory.name: ts
field_inventory.description: Optional event Unix epoch timestamp is documented as ten digits in UTC. No freshness window is inferred.

field_inventory.name: idfa
field_inventory.description: Optional local format advisory for the documented uppercase Apple IDFA. Cross-platform mandatory labels do not establish when this ID is applicable.

field_inventory.name: aaid
field_inventory.description: Optional local format advisory for the documented lowercase Android Advertising ID. No simultaneous Apple and Android ID requirement is inferred.

field_inventory.name: idfv
field_inventory.description: The vendor ID is described as applicable to iOS only. Applicability, alternatives and the mandatory table label require integration context.

field_inventory.name: data
field_inventory.description: The guide allows event metadata as JSON or a single string. No JSON-only syntax or custom-member schema is imposed.

field_inventory.name: non_app_event
field_inventory.description: Optional literal true or false. BI forwarding requires true when caller context establishes a non-app event; that context cannot be inferred from an event name.

field_inventory.name: country
field_inventory.description: Optional ISO alpha-2 country-code shape only. Registry membership and geographic truth are not checked.

field_inventory.name: currency
field_inventory.description: Optional ISO 4217 currency-code shape only. Account currency, registry dates and value conversion remain external.

field_inventory.name: device_name
field_inventory.description: Optional Device name.

field_inventory.name: os_name
field_inventory.description: Optional OS name; android and ios are examples, not a closed enumeration.

field_inventory.name: os_version
field_inventory.description: Optional OS version.

field_inventory.name: app_version
field_inventory.description: Optional Application version.

field_inventory.name: user
field_inventory.description: Optional Customer user ID.

field_inventory.name: revenue
field_inventory.description: Optional Revenue in micro currency units; no sign, range or exact scalar grammar is established.

field_inventory.name: revenue_float
field_inventory.description: Optional Alternative revenue notation; no sign, range or mutual-exclusion rule is imposed.

field_inventory.name: operator
field_inventory.description: Optional Mobile operator or carrier.

field_inventory.name: zipcode
field_inventory.description: Optional Regional postal code.

field_inventory.name: city
field_inventory.description: Optional City name; UN/LOCODE standardization is guidance.

field_inventory.name: country_subdivision
field_inventory.description: Optional State or subdivision name.

field_inventory.name: partner_device_id
field_inventory.description: Optional Partner user ID.

field_inventory.name: ip
field_inventory.description: Optional IP address; receiver family and representation rules remain open.

field_inventory.name: language
field_inventory.description: Optional Simple or extended language value; examples admit both hyphen and underscore.

field_inventory.name: sdk
field_inventory.description: Optional Client SDK version.

params.description: The public event-forwarding interface documents GET.

unimplemented_or_external_requirements: Regional eu5 creative/video callbacks are outside this exact endpoint.
Cross-platform ID applicability and identity alternatives are ambiguous in the mandatory table; no unconditional IDFA, AAID or IDFV requirement is inferred.
BI context and non_app_event=true applicability cannot be inferred from event names alone.
Account keys, attribution, delivery and HTTP204 success require external context.
Throughput1k/sec, real-time forwarding and App Open10-minute scheduling require multiple requests and wall-clock/session context.
JSON metadata can also be a single string, so arbitrary JSON syntax is not rejected.
Registered country/currency membership, revenue grammar and optional-field receiver semantics remain open.
